why.T3-188: The concepts are an organised Polish room setting its coordinated plan apart from uncontrolled placers and denying it controls every Polish pixel, which is T3-188 rather than merely tracing an attacker.

why.T3-150: Most concepts propose or join alliances for joint defence or a joint fight, e.g. proposed alliance with r/SquareSpiral and joining forces against the Void.
why.T3-084: Several concepts are direct requests to another room for help with the work, e.g. asking for spare pixels to maintain the Glorious Spiral or asking r/bopp to help build the portal dwarf.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-150's alliance gate does not reach direct requests for pixels or help where no standing alliance is formed.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: T3-084's gate is satisfied by requests to other canvas rooms to send pixels or help build the portal dwarf.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-084; dropping it would lose the outright requests for help, leaving only alliance formation.

why.T3-021: The majority of concepts are maintenance and repair of the pattern: preserving, fixing pixels, cleaning and tending the pattern.
why.T3-005: Several concepts call for active defence against attackers, including defensive stations and stopping the white line/Void attack.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-021's upkeep gate does not reach calls to fight an attack or hold defensive stations.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: T3-005's gate is satisfied by calls to defend the pattern against the Void/white line and to man defensive stations.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-005; dropping it would lose the active-defence framing, leaving repair/maintenance.

why.T3-041: The concepts choose how to extend the pattern into new adjacent area, which is the room adding pieces or enlarging its existing work.

why.T3-021: Most concepts are fixing, cleaning, restoring and maintaining the Wave and album covers against stray or accidental pixels.
why.T3-005: Many concepts call to protect the Wave from vandalism and fight the Void/attackers, which is active defence.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-021's repair gate does not reach calls to fight attackers, protect at all costs, or stop vandals.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: T3-005's gate is satisfied by defence calls against vandalism and the Void attacking the Wave.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-005; dropping it would lose the active-defence response, leaving repair and upkeep.

why.T3-009: The concepts celebrate and thank contributors for the pattern's growth and survival, marking the shared work as achieved.

why.T3-070: The concepts provide guides, images, mapping and how-to for the pattern, which is sharing coordinates/templates and construction guidance.
why.T3-169: Several concepts propose signs, stamps or inscriptions bearing the sub/pattern name, which is signing the sub's name.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-070's guide/template gate does not reach signs and inscriptions whose point is marking the pattern's name.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: T3-169's gate is satisfied by proposed signs, stamps and inscriptions carrying R/PLACEPORTALPATTERN or r/bopp.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-169; dropping it would lose the naming/signing aspect, leaving guides and images.
